name: vlogops
description: BUILD-006 Phases 1-2 — the durable Content Seed store, the three human-initiated intake routes, and the Source Compiler. A seed's identity is a function of its content and nothing else; captured source bytes are frozen at intake so a source edited, corrupted or deleted afterwards cannot rewrite history; the same source taken in twice yields one seed; and an intake killed mid-flight recovers to exactly one correct state with nobody re-running it. The compiler turns a sealed seed into a bounded, deduplicated, chronological, provenance-complete evidence pack whose identity is likewise a pure function of its content, reading only the frozen snapshots and never the original source. Additive-only `vlogops` schema — it never touches asdair, session_report, ops, tower or any other namespace.
